title: Psionic asset recruited through the GATE program

tellings.quote: interviewed yesterday a psionic asset who was recruited through the gate program

plain: The government is said to have found people with claimed psychic abilities, which it calls "psionic assets", through the GATE program, the name used in American schools for gifted-and-talented classes. Michels says that the day before, he had interviewed one such person who was recruited this way. He does not name the person. If true, it would mean schoolchildren were being screened for psychic talent.
